lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in semi-regular horizontal and vertical rows. The anterior section shows smaller, more densely packed spots that transition into a larger, more spaced grid pattern posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal ridges, with high-intensity circular blobs positioned at the approximate intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally across the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (Echeneidae) visible in the lower right quadrant, positioned ventrally to the main body of the whale shark.
